A bewitching gaze that fixes upon you. A tenderness so profound you'd abandon everything to make it yours. Can you resist the allure of this work?

[3_1_artwork.jpg]

Work No. 34. This piece is restrained within a metal frame modeled after an easel. Treating the girl as a living canvas, this work allows you to create art using your semen as paint.
The piece possesses a unique constitution where bathing in semen or inhaling its scent heightens her entire body's sensitivity. For her, semen is like a natural aphrodisiac.
You can bukkake her face and body, rub your cock against her, make her perform titfucking or deepthroat. You can also take personal items she used when she was human and ejaculate onto her shoes or clothes. Please use your semen to stain this canvas.

However, please refrain from inserting anything into the vagina. For the work to lose its purity is like a painting being cut to pieces, and it is essential for preserving the work's value.
However, this particular piece, fully aware of this, tempts visitors with lines like: “My pussy is so soft and slippery, it feels amazing, you know~?” “I want you to cum inside me, all the way~♡” Please do not succumb to that temptation...

[3_2_artwork.jpg]

When the work was human, she seems to have been a somewhat troubled girl. After her parents divorced when she was young, she closed herself off emotionally. She couldn't fit in with her classmates throughout elementary and junior high school, spending her childhood feeling like she didn't belong anywhere. She apparently refused to attend high school starting midway through her second year.
However, while she can be a bit twisted, she's actually very friendly at heart. She has a mischievous side that enjoys teasing people, and her provocative behavior toward visitors might stem from that.

Like the other works, she was brought here against her will. Yet she seems to relish her situation, tempting visitors with her words and gestures. I believe this stems from her self-destructive mindset.
For someone who always said things like “It doesn't matter” or “Let it all go to hell,” her current situation might not seem so bad after all. Visitors can easily get swept up in her aura and end up touching the exhibit... Please enjoy viewing the works with restraint to avoid that happening.
